title: Salon Two-Way SMS Messaging | Bella Booking Australia

facts.fact: Bella Booking's Messages Plus add-on is required for two-way messaging with a dedicated number, SMS and email campaigns, and automatic birthday, new-client and follow-up messages, and it is an add-on to any paid plan.
facts.quote: Messages Plus is an add-on to any paid plan: two-way messaging with a new dedicated number, just for your business, SMS and email campaigns

facts.fact: A salon with 5 team members using two-way messaging at the front desk pays A$99/month on the Professional plan, per Bella Booking's pricing example, with no per-seat fees and no commission.
facts.quote: A salon with 5 team members using two-way messaging at the front desk pays just A$99/month

facts.fact: Messages Plus adds 100 extra SMS credits per month, which never expire, according to Bella Booking.
facts.quote: Messages Plus adds 100 extra SMS credits a month, which never expire

facts.fact: Bella Booking's free trial lasts 14 days and requires no credit card.
facts.quote: Start your 14-day free trial. No credit card required.

facts.fact: For marketing-only opt-out, clients reply NO PROMOS or STOP MARKETING in Bella Booking, while STOP stops all SMS to that client.
facts.quote: STOP stops all SMS to that client; for marketing-only opt-out, clients use NO PROMOS / STOP MARKETING.

facts.fact: Email campaigns are unlimited within Messages Plus, subject to fair use, according to Bella Booking.
facts.quote: Email campaigns are unlimited within Messages Plus (fair use)

facts.fact: Bella Booking's New message notification is on by default for owners and admins, and each team member can switch it on or off.
facts.quote: It is on by default for owners and admins, and each team member can switch it on or off.

facts.fact: Bella Booking's Suggest with AI feature drafts replies to clients, and the user edits the draft and sends it themselves.
facts.quote: You edit the draft and send it yourself.

facts.fact: With Messages Plus, Bella Booking's AI drafts email subject and body for editing and never auto-sends them, and checks SMS against anti-spam rules before sending.
facts.quote: describe an email in a sentence and Bella Booking drafts a subject and body for you to edit - never auto-sent.
